parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit) that makes a
retried request safe. The service always runs on Postgres, so it is
required on every deployment and answered with 400
`idempotency-key-required` when absent; a replay with the same key and
the same request (method, path and body) returns the original response
with the header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, while the same key with a
different request is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. A key longer than 128
characters is also 400 `idempotency-key-required`. A 4xx answer is stored
and replayed like a success; a 5xx is never stored.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: The site id (the facility site code).
